candidate_empirical_probability_rule: Over = (hits > line in 4 prior regular-season games + 2)/(4+4); Under uses hits < line; push if at-line, preserve separately. Fixed Beta(2,2) smoothing. This is a crude, independent and uncalibrated empirical challenger, not a validated winning probability.
eligible_source_rows_must_match: Exact source event UUID/player norm/market/side/line with original fusion, unique official ESPN scheduled fixture (home, away, <=3 minutes) and player team. Fail closed.
historic_player_stats_cutoff: 2026 regular-season completed weeks 1 through 4 exclusively; exclude any week 5+ records, even those already final at freeze time.
market_adjusted_challenger_rule: 0.8 * frozen source sportsbook reference plus 0.2 * empirical smoothed hit frequency, computed separately for PROP and PrizePicks source probabilities. Comparison only, no automatic picks.
pregame_quote_requirements: Provider quote last_updated must parse as a UTC timestamp <= original freeze and < official kickoff. If >24h age, research only/stale.
purpose: Frozen candidate-only empirical player-form challenger vs corresponding sportsbook reference in NFL PROP and separate PrizePicks lanes. Not a proven betting strategy.
